page: Microsoft Azure D16alds_v7 is a virtual machine from the Daldsv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The server is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 945 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression tests placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations also demonstrate average performance, while text processing and small-model LLM text generation benchmarks achieve top-tier results.

Given its high clock speed and lower memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:2, this instance offers a compute-focused resource profile. It provides a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring strong single-threaded processing power without massive memory footprints. The bundled 945 GB local storage supports applications needing fast local scratch space. This configuration is suitable for tasks such as software compilation, text processing, web serving, and light machine learning inference.
